entry.author: Catherine Murray

content.value:
The EPL Board is pleased to let you know that the recruitment process for EPL’s next chief executive has concluded with the Board approving the appointment of Lara Ariell to the role. Lara is currently a Group Manager at the Ministry of Social Development. Her leadership kete includes senior roles at Inland Revenue, Tertiary Education Commission and Ministry of Justice.

Lara demonstrated a genuine interest in EPL, what it has achieved to date, and its future potential. She brings a depth of experience as a chief financial officer and in business process improvement and enabling technology implementations.

Lara will commence as EPL’s chief executive on Monday 5 December.

Ngā mihi / warm regards
Sandi Beatie
EPL Board Chair

22 August 2022
